title: Flask Authentication & Authorization API
summary: A REST API with authentication and role-based access control built from scratch, without Flask-Login or Flask-JWT.
highlights: JWT Bearer tokens and database-backed sessions, bcrypt password hashing
Per-role, per-resource and owner-based permissions, plus an admin API
pytest test suite that runs in GitHub Actions

title: Expense Analytics CLI
summary: A Python command-line expense tracker with category analytics and CSV storage.
highlights: Add expenses with input validation, then view totals per category
Filter by category; data persists in a local CSV file
Standard library only, with 11 unittest tests

title: Logistics Company Platform
summary: Accounting and data-control system for a logistics company: a Flask backend with PostgreSQL behind a React website and React Native apps.
highlights: Flask backend and PostgreSQL database for the company's accounting and data control
Driver app that takes photos and scans data via OCR or QR codes
Captured data appears on the website, where an administrator edits and approves it
note: The code belongs to the client and is not public

title: Arabic Language Courses Website
summary: Course website with a React frontend, a Flask backend and a PostgreSQL database.
note: The code belongs to the client and is not public
